description_en: Modifies the binding relationship of a 700 number
kebab_example: aliyun dyplsapi update-subs-700 --pool-key FC100000168480000 --operate-type updateNoA --subs-id 1000000000 --telx 700000000000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateSubs700

parameters.help_en: The key of the number pool
parameters.name: pool_key

parameters.help_en:
updateNoA: Updates number A.
updateNoB: Updates number B.
updateExpire: Updates the validity period of the binding relationship.
updateGroup: Updates number group G.
updateNoDefaultA: Updates the default callback number A in GXB mode.
updateCallRestrict: Sets single-call restrictions.
updateOutId: Updates the OutId field.
updateIsRecordingEnabled: Updates the recording status in the binding.
updateAsr: Updates the ASR status in the binding.
updateAudio: Updates the ringtone configuration in the binding
parameters.help_zh:
updateNoA：修改 A 号码。
updateNoB：修改 B 号码。
updateExpire：修改绑定关系有效期。
updateGroup：修改 G 号码组。
updateNoDefaultA：GXB模式中修改默认回呼叫A号码。
updateCallRestrict：设置单通呼叫限制。
updateOutId：更新 OutId 字段。
updateIsRecordingEnabled：更新绑定中录音状态。
updateAsr：更新绑定中 ASR 状态。
updateAudio：更新绑定铃音配置
parameters.name: operate_type

parameters.help_en: The binding relationship ID, which uniquely identifies a number binding relationship
parameters.help_zh: 绑定关系ID，用于唯一识别号码绑定关系
parameters.name: subs_id

parameters.help_en: The intermediate number X. If the business user does not specify an X number, the platform assigns one from the number pool as the X number
parameters.help_zh: 中间号X。业务使用方未指定X号码时，由应用平台从号码池中指定一个号码作为X号码
parameters.name: telx

parameters.help_en: The order ID. This parameter is required in practice. Encrypt the order ID before submission because it is reported to the regulatory platform
parameters.help_zh: 订单 ID(实际上必填， 建议客户进行订单号加密，用于报送监管平台)
parameters.name: order_id

parameters.help_en: Optional. The Industrial Internet identifier code, which has a one-to-one correspondence with OrderID. The code supports delimiter characters such as "." and "/" to separate code domains. The code must not contain non-printable characters such as spaces or line feeds. This parameter is required when the business user generates the Industrial Internet identifier code independently
parameters.help_zh:
可选工业互联网标识编码，与OrderID保持一一对应关系。编码支持“.”、“/”等字符分割编码域，编码中不得含有不可显示类字符，如空格符、换行符等。
当业务使用方自行生成工业互联网标识编码时，该字段必选
parameters.name: industrial_id

parameters.help_en: The number A to update in the binding relationship
parameters.help_zh: 修改绑定关系中的A号码
parameters.name: tela

parameters.help_en:
Number A. The DefaultA number for GXB private numbers.

Note

The callback mode can be configured at the number pool level. When the callback mode is set to default mode, this field takes effect. When number B calls number X, the call is forwarded to this number A by default. If number A is not configured, the call cannot be connected.

To update number A, call the number binding modification operation
parameters.help_zh:
A号码
GXB 隐私号的 DefaultA号码。
说明
支持在号池维度设置回拨模式，当回拨模式为默认模式时，此字段生效，即 B 号码拨打 X 号码时，默认会转接到 此 A 号码，如 A 号码未设置，则无法接通。
如需更新 A 号码，请调用 号码绑定修改接口
parameters.name: defaulta

parameters.help_en: The number B to update in the binding relationship
parameters.help_zh: 修改绑定关系中的B号码
parameters.name: telb

parameters.help_en: The GroupID to update in the binding relationship
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The validity period to update for the binding relationship
parameters.help_zh: 修改绑定关系的有效时间
parameters.name: expiration

parameters.help_en: The single-call restriction logic to update
parameters.help_zh: 修改单通呼叫限制逻辑
parameters.name: call_restrict

parameters.help_en: The media selection to update in the binding relationship
parameters.help_zh: 修改中绑定关系中的媒体选择
parameters.name: need_record

parameters.help_en:
Optional. The audio prompt code.
AXB mode

ACallX_Apre: The audio prompt code played to A before the call is connected when A calls number X.

ACallX_Ain: The audio prompt code played to A after the call is connected when A calls number X.

ACallX_Bin: The audio prompt code played to B after the call is connected when A calls number X.

BCallX_Bpre: The audio prompt code played to B before the call is connected when B calls number X.

BCallX_Ain: The audio prompt code played to A after the call is connected when B calls number X.

BCallX_Bin: The audio prompt code played to B after the call is connected when B calls number X.

GXB mode

GCallX_Gpre: The audio prompt code played to the caller before the call is connected when a number in group G calls number X.

GCallX_Gin: The audio prompt code played to the caller after the call is connected when a number in group G calls number X.

GCallX_Bin: The audio prompt code played to B after the call is connected when a number in group G calls number X.

BCallX_Bpre: The audio prompt code played to B before the call is connected when B calls number X.

BCallX_Gin: The audio prompt code played to the callee after the call is connected when calling number X.

BCallX_Bin: The audio prompt code played to B after the call is connected when B calls number X
parameters.help_zh:
可选放音编码
AXB模式

ACallX_ApreA呼叫X号码时，呼叫接通前，向A播放的语音提示放音编码。

ACallX_AinA呼叫X号码时，呼叫接通后，向A播放的语音提示放音编码。

ACallX_BinA呼叫X号码时，呼叫接通后，向B播放的语音提示放音编码。

BCallX_BpreB呼叫X号码时，呼叫接通前，向B播放的语音提示放音编码。

BCallX_Ain B呼叫X号码时，呼叫接通后，向A播放的语音提示放音编码。

BCallX_Bin      B呼叫X号码时，呼叫接通后，向B播放的语音提示放音编码。

GXB模式

GCallX_Gpre号码组G中的号码呼叫X号码时，呼叫接通前，向主叫播放的语音提示放音编码。

GCallX_Gin号码组G中的号码呼叫X号码时，呼叫接通后，向主叫播放的语音提示放音编码。

GCallX_Bin号码组G中的号码呼叫X号码时，呼叫接通后，向B播放的语音提示放音编码。

BCallX_BpreB呼叫X号码时，呼叫接通前，向B播放的语音提示放音编码。

BCallX_Gin呼叫X号码时，呼叫接通后，向被叫播放的语音提示放音编码。

BCallX_BinB呼叫X号码时，呼叫接通后，向B播放的语音提示放音编码
